about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Tahitian Poisson Cru Coconut Fish Salad
recipes.summary: Fresh tuna cured briefly in lime juice, then dressed with coconut milk, cucumber and tomato.
steps: Toss the tuna with the lime juice and a pinch of salt and leave in the fridge for 10 minutes, until the outside turns opaque and firm.
Drain off most of the lime juice.
Fold through the cucumber, tomato, onion, carrot and chilli.
Stir in the coconut milk and coriander and serve immediately, very cold.
notes: Food safety: use only very fresh sashimi-grade fish kept below 4°C. The lime only firms the outside, so the fish stays raw inside. Avoid for pregnant, elderly, young or immunocompromised people. Eat the same day.

recipes.title: Salvadoran Curtido Cabbage Slaw
recipes.summary: Lightly fermented-style cabbage, carrot and oregano slaw served with pupusas and grilled meat.
steps: Pour boiling water over the cabbage in a bowl, stand 1 minute, until just wilted, then drain and cool.
Mix with the carrot, onion and chilli in a large jar.
Dissolve the sugar and salt in the vinegar and hot water, then add the oregano and pour over the vegetables.
Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours before serving, until the cabbage is tangy and crunchy.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 2 weeks.

recipes.title: Mexican Sopa Azteca Tortilla Soup
recipes.summary: Smoky tomato and chilli broth with crisp tortilla strips, avocado, lime and shredded chicken.
steps: Fry the tortilla strips in 2 tbsp oil for 2 minutes, until crisp and golden, and drain on paper.
Blend the tomato, half the onion, garlic and chillies, then fry in the remaining oil for 8 minutes, until darker and thick.
Add the stock and the chicken and simmer gently for 15 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C in the centre.
Shred the chicken, return it to the soup and season with salt.
Serve topped with tortilla strips, avocado, ricotta, coriander and a wedge of lime.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the centre and the juices run clear.

recipes.title: Mexican Salsa Macha Peanut and Chilli Oil
recipes.summary: Dark, nutty chilli oil with peanuts, garlic and sesame, spooned onto eggs, tacos and noodles.
steps: Warm the oil in a small pot over low heat, then add the garlic and cook 3 minutes, until pale gold.
Add the peanuts and sesame and cook 2 minutes, until fragrant and lightly golden.
Take off the heat, stir in the chilli flakes, vinegar, sugar and salt and let it settle until the sizzling stops.
Pulse briefly for a chunky texture, then cool and jar.
notes: Keeps in a clean jar in the fridge for up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Swedish Gubbröra Egg and Anchovy Spread
recipes.summary: Chopped egg, onion and anchovy with dill and sour cream, piled on rye crispbread at Midsummer.
steps: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool in cold water, peel and chop.
Fold the eggs with the anchovies, onion, sour cream, mayonnaise and herbs.
Season with pepper and chill for 15 minutes, then pile onto the rye bread.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are firm, keep chilled and eat within 24 hours.

recipes.title: Icelandic Kjötsúpa Lamb and Root Vegetable Soup
recipes.summary: Plain, hearty lamb soup with swede, potato, carrot and rice, the Icelandic Sunday soup.
steps: Cover the lamb with the water, bring to a boil and skim until no foam rises.
Simmer for 60 minutes with the onion and bay leaves, until the meat is very tender and falling from the bone.
Add the rice, swede, potato, carrot and thyme and simmer 20 minutes, until the vegetables are soft.
Remove the bones, shred the meat and add the cabbage, then simmer 5 minutes, until wilted, and season.
notes: Food safety: cook the lamb until very tender and at least 75°C in the centre.

recipes.title: Danish Hønsesalat Chicken and Asparagus Salad
recipes.summary: Creamy chicken salad with asparagus and pineapple for open sandwiches.
steps: Boil the asparagus for 3 minutes, until bright green and just tender, then cool and cut in short lengths.
Stir the mayonnaise, sour cream and curry powder until smooth.
Fold in the chicken, asparagus, pineapple, celery and chives, then season.
Chill for 20 minutes and serve on rye bread or with lettuce.
notes: Food safety: use chicken cooked to 75°C and cooled quickly, keep the salad chilled and eat within 2 days.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Shopska Salad
recipes.summary: Tomato, cucumber and pepper salad under a thick drift of grated white cheese.
steps: Toss the tomato, cucumber, capsicum and onion with the oil, vinegar and salt.
Rest 5 minutes, until the vegetables begin to release their juice.
Pile on a platter and cover thickly with the grated feta and parsley.
notes: Serve immediately so the cheese stays fluffy.

recipes.title: Bulgarian Kyopolou Smoked Aubergine Dip
recipes.summary: Charred aubergine and pepper dip with garlic, parsley and oil.
steps: Char the aubergines and capsicums over a flame or under a hot grill for 25 minutes, turning, until blackened and collapsed.
Rest covered 10 minutes, then peel and drain away the juices.
Chop the flesh finely and mix with the garlic, oil, vinegar and salt.
Fold in the parsley and tomato, then chill for 30 minutes.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for up to 3 days.

recipes.title: Romanian Zacusca Vegetable Spread
recipes.summary: Slow-cooked aubergine, pepper and tomato spread, jarred in autumn for bread.
steps: Char the aubergines and capsicums under a hot grill for 25 minutes, turning, until blackened and soft, then peel and chop fine.
Fry the onion in the oil for 10 minutes, until golden, then add the tomatoes and bay leaves.
Add the aubergine and capsicum and simmer on low heat for 80 minutes, stirring often, until very thick and the oil separates.
Stir in the garlic, sugar and salt for the last 10 minutes of cooking.
Pack into clean jars and cool before chilling.
notes: Keeps in the fridge in sealed clean jars for up to 3 weeks.

recipes.title: Ukrainian Deruny Potato Pancakes
recipes.summary: Lacy grated potato and onion pancakes served with sour cream.
steps: Grate the potato and onion and squeeze very dry in a clean towel, then stir in the egg, flour, salt and pepper.
Heat the oil in a wide pan and spoon in the batter in flat rounds.
Fry for 4 minutes each side, until deep golden and crisp, then drain on paper.
Serve hot with sour cream.
notes: Food safety: cook the pancakes until golden and set throughout.

recipes.title: Czech Bramboracka Potato and Mushroom Soup
recipes.summary: Rustic soup of potato, root vegetables and dried mushroom with marjoram and caraway.
steps: Melt the butter and soften the onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes, until golden and the liquid cooks off.
Stir in the flour for 1 minute, then add the stock, potato, carrot, celery, caraway and marjoram.
Simmer for 20 minutes, until the potato is very tender, then crush a few pieces with a spoon to thicken.
Stir in the garlic, season and serve hot.
notes: Add a little water if the soup becomes too thick.

recipes.title: Slovak Kapustnica Sauerkraut Soup
recipes.summary: Smoked sausage and sauerkraut soup with paprika and a little cream, the Christmas Eve soup.
steps: Fry the bacon and sausage in the oil for 6 minutes, until browned, then add the onion for 4 minutes, until soft.
Stir in the garlic and paprika, then add the sauerkraut, mushrooms, water and bay leaves.
Simmer for 40 minutes, then add the potato and cook 15 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Stir in the cream, season with pepper and serve hot.
notes: Food safety: heat the sausage until steaming hot and above 75°C throughout.

recipes.title: Jamaican Festival Sweet Fried Dumplings
recipes.summary: Sweet cornmeal dumplings fried until crisp outside and tender within.
steps: Mix the flour, cornmeal, sugar, baking powder and salt, then stir in the vanilla and milk to a soft dough.
Knead for 2 minutes, until smooth, then roll into 8 finger-length shapes.
Heat the oil to 170°C and fry the dumplings in batches for 5 minutes, turning, until deep golden.
Drain on paper and serve warm.
notes: Keep the oil at a steady 170°C so the centres cook through.

recipes.title: Guyanese Cook-up Rice
recipes.summary: One-pot coconut rice with black-eyed beans, chicken and thyme.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil for 6 minutes, until golden on all sides, then add the onion and garlic for 3 minutes.
Add the coconut milk, water, beans, thyme, chilli and salt and bring to a simmer until the chicken is just cooked.
Stir in the rice, cover and cook on low heat for 20 minutes, until the rice is tender and the liquid absorbed.
Rest 10 minutes, stir through the spring onions and remove the chilli and thyme.
notes: Food safety: cook the chicken until it reaches 75°C in the centre and no pink remains.

recipes.title: Nigerian Ofada Ata Rodo Pepper Sauce
recipes.summary: Deep, fiery pepper sauce of roasted capsicum and chilli fried in oil with onion and locust-free seasoning.
steps: Roast the capsicums and chillies at 220°C for 25 minutes, until blackened and collapsed, then blend with half the onion and the garlic to a coarse puree.
Heat the oil until shimmering, then fry the remaining sliced onion for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the puree and cook on medium heat for 20 minutes, stirring, until the sauce is thick and the oil rises to the surface.
Season with the cumin, stock cube and salt and serve with rice.
notes: Keeps in a jar in the fridge for up to 1 week.

recipes.title: Nigerian Dodo Fried Plantain
recipes.summary: Ripe plantain fried until caramelised at the edges, a favourite side with eggs or stew.
steps: Toss the plantain slices with the salt and chilli flakes.
Heat the oil in a wide pan over medium heat to about 170°C.
Fry in batches for 3 minutes each side, until deep golden and caramelised at the edges.
Drain on paper and serve hot.
notes: Choose plantains with black-spotted skins for the sweetest dodo.

recipes.title: Ghanaian Kontomire Spinach Stew
recipes.summary: Spinach stewed with onion, tomato and chilli in oil, served with boiled yam or rice and eggs.
steps: Blend the tomato, half the onion, the chillies, garlic and ginger to a smooth sauce.
Fry the remaining onion in the oil for 5 minutes, until golden, then add the sauce and cook 15 minutes, until thick and the oil separates.
Add the spinach and stock cube and simmer for 8 minutes, until the leaves are soft but still green.
Boil the eggs for 9 minutes until firm, peel and halve them.
Season and serve the stew with the eggs.
notes: Food safety: boil the eggs until the yolks are firm.

recipes.title: Georgian Ajapsandali Vegetable Stew
recipes.summary: Summer stew of aubergine, tomato, pepper and potato with plenty of coriander and basil.
steps: Salt the aubergine and rest 10 minutes, then pat dry and brown in oil for 8 minutes, until golden.
Soften the onion in the same pan for 5 minutes, then add the potato and capsicum and cook 10 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, aubergine, garlic and chilli and simmer 20 minutes, until the vegetables are tender and the sauce thick.
Stir in the herbs and season, serving warm or at room temperature.
notes: Resting the salted aubergine is not included in the prep time.

recipes.title: Polish Naleśniki Ricotta Crepes
recipes.summary: Thin crepes rolled around a sweet ricotta filling and browned in butter.
steps: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk and sugar into a smooth thin batter.
Cook thin crepes in a buttered pan for 1 to 2 minutes each side, until golden.
Mix the ricotta with the vanilla and lemon zest.
Fill and roll up the crepes, then brown them in the remaining butter for 2 minutes, until golden.
Dust with icing sugar and serve warm.
notes: Food safety: cook the crepes until fully set and golden since the batter contains raw egg.

recipes.title: Estonian Mulgikapsad Sauerkraut and Barley Stew
recipes.summary: Slow-braised sauerkraut with pork and pearl barley, a winter dish from Mulgi.
steps: Brown the pork in the oil for 8 minutes, until golden, then add the onion and carrot for 4 minutes.
Add the sauerkraut, barley, caraway, tomato paste and water.
Cover and simmer for 70 minutes, until the pork is tender and the barley is soft.
Season and serve with boiled potatoes.
notes: Food safety: cook the pork until tender and at least 75°C in the centre of the pieces.

recipes.title: Brazilian Vinagrete Tomato and Onion Salsa
recipes.summary: Chopped tomato, onion and capsicum in a vinegar dressing for churrasco and feijoada.
steps: Combine the tomato, onion, capsicum and parsley in a bowl.
Add the vinegar, oil, salt and pepper and stir until the vegetables are glossy.
Rest 15 minutes until the juices have mingled, then serve.
notes: Best eaten within a few hours.
